purpose: Pinned speech-emotion (SER) backbones for plan step M12. Holds no machine path, token or weight. No model here feeds routing, the crisis pre-check, a hard override or a forced band. SER may contribute to D4 only under decision D-8, after its promotion gate passes.

models.licence: FunASR Model Open Source License v1.1 (attribution; model names retained; terms may be revised upstream)
models.use: frozen inference only: zero-shot 9-class head mapped to 5 affect classes, and utterance embeddings for a SAHAY-trained 5-class head
models.environment: sahay-ser-e2v (isolated; FunASR). Never loaded in sahay-ml-models.
models.contamination: possibly_seen_in_pretraining for RAVDESS and CREMA-D (seed stage trained on EmoBox; later fine-tuning data unpublished)

models.licence: CC BY-SA 3.0 (UniSpeech licence linked from the model card); fine-tuned derivatives stay private
models.use: fine-tuned 5-class SER head (top layers trainable, CNN feature encoder frozen) in sahay-ml-models
models.environment: sahay-ml-models (EXT-118 pins; transformers loads WavLM natively)
models.contamination: none known for RAVDESS or CREMA-D (self-supervised on Libri-Light, GigaSpeech and VoxPopuli)
